title: pilosella acutifolia subsp. villarsii
intro: Pilosella acutifolia subsp. villarsii, commonly known as Villars' mouse-ear, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Villars' mouse-ear include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential interactions of this plant.
